_note: The contractors holding the pilot running rooms, one entry per SITE.
A firm may hold more than one site: Prabhakar Enterprises holds both ROHA and
IGP, confirmed by the officer on 02.09.2026. Two entries carrying the same
code are the same firm under two agreements, which is what the paperwork is.
IGP's agreement has ARRIVED and is entered below from the executed GeM
contract. The other three are still awaited, so the loader writes an agreement
number beginning AGREEMENT-AWAITED/ and leaves the period blank rather than
assuming one -- an assumed date anchors the standing-obligation clocks and was
twice mistaken for a real one.
A firm's name matters beyond the paperwork: the FSSAI licence for a kitchen is
issued to the licensee named on it, so the Form C for each of these sites
should stand in the name of the firm shown here. A licence in another firm's
name is a finding, not a clerical difference.
